tasks.title: Vet the lesson scripts
tasks.detail: Red-pen every lesson in the editor, status draft → vetted. Includes the school-verb check: does her school say "borrow" or "take" for the carry? L-ADD-4 and L-SUB-4 both use "borrow".

tasks.title: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY into .env
tasks.detail: Unblocks the bake console. Add AZURE_SPEECH_KEY=… and, if not uksouth, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION=…. The file is gitignored; the key never enters the page.

tasks.title: Voice casting: audition, then set joe/voices.json
tasks.detail: Placeholder en-GB voices are in place so the pipeline runs. Everything re-bakes on change — casting is data, so changing Fred marks every clip stale and one batch bake fixes it.

tasks.title: Red-pen joe/noun-candidates.json
tasks.detail: Nouns drafted in editor dialect for the words ladder. Blocks Run D top rungs. The file arrives with Run D; this task is open ahead of it so the queue shows what is coming.

tasks.title: Strike the rejects in joe/pairs-audit.json
tasks.detail: Every close-spelled trap pair must be distinct in HER accent, not in a dictionary. Blocks Run D trap rungs. File arrives with Run D.

tasks.title: Record the 43 phonemes
tasks.detail: Sound booth. Eternal — recorded once, used forever. Unblocks Fred-talk clips.

tasks.title: Evening after Run A: hand-tick taking-away 1
tasks.detail: Grown-ups panel → takingAway → Manual → tick stage 1. This is the QA department getting subtraction. Untick is a parent's hand, not a demotion, so it is safe to try.

tasks.title: Three rulings the attempt model needs (A2)
tasks.detail: The A2 survey hit three cases the spec does not cover. Answer in the note; A2's build reads them. (1) THE PEEK — tapping the grey ? on a sum reveals the answer and the round goes inert; she never answers. Is that no attempt at all, an attempt excluded like help, or an incorrect one? It decides whether a peeked stage reads as unpractised or as fine. (2) IS 'SAY IT AGAIN' HELP? The spec names dot-hints and Fred-talk only. If repeating the prompt is not help, find pages — which have no other affordance — are never help-excluded at all. (3) ABANDONMENT — she taps the X mid-page. Absent a ruling CC records nothing, on the grounds that silence is not evidence of getting it wrong; say if you want it counted. Full reasoning in docs/pet-island-runA.md, FIELD NOTES — A2.
